# Bontalico

> > Bontalico is an Italian artisanal food marketplace connecting consumers with authentic, small-producer regional specialties and traditional Italian cuisine.

Bontalico.com is a curated marketplace dedicated to showcasing authentic Italian food products from small regional producers across Italy's most renowned culinary regions. The platform combines e-commerce functionality with educational content about Italian cuisine, regional specialties, and traditional recipes.

## Key Topics

- Italian artisanal products
- Regional specialties
- Small producers
- Italian cuisine
- DOP/IGP/PAT certifications
- Italian regions (Toscana, Sardegna, Sicilia, Umbria)
- Traditional recipes
- Food guides
- Italian food marketplace
- Authentic food sourcing
- Regional food culture
- Italian food blog

## Core Marketplace

- [Home](https://bontalico.com): Bontalico marketplace for authentic Italian artisanal products from small producers
- [Shopping Cart](https://bontalico.com/carrello): Shopping cart page for purchasing Italian food products
- [Account](https://bontalico.com/account): User account login and registration page for Bontalico platform

## About & Community

- [Chi Siamo (About Us)](https://bontalico.com/chi-siamo): About Bontalico: Italian food enthusiasts supporting small regional producers
- [Blog](https://bontalico.com/blog): Italian food blog featuring recipes, cuisine guides, and regional specialties

## Customer Support
